Week 1 down.

Colts lost a rather unimpressive match against the Buffalo Bills

THE GOOD THE BAD AND THE UGLY

THE GOOD

Not too much good here. I tried to find SOMEthing good to say. Best thing to say is that we get to come home to play the Jets next week.

 

THE BAD

Piss poor play for most of the game. Luck was 26-49, but more importantly was several really key plays where Luck underthrew TY Hilton, one of which resulted in an INT and the other should have been picked off as well. Both plays in the first half were just indicative of an offensive line who wouldn't give Luck a second to set his feet and a quarterback who just didn't seem to get the ball where he wanted it.

 

THE UGLY

2 major glaring issues. One is the amount of effort the Colts were playing with. They looked like a 2nd or 3rd string out there for half of the game. For the first 3 quarters there just was not the effort that showed up in the fourth, whether it was a stupid penalty or if it was something else.

The second major ugly thing in the game, was simple football knowledge. The Colts missed tackle after tackle, misread plays, didn't cover the release man, etc. It was just SIMPLE stuff that they mucked up on which made it even more infuriating.

 

OVERALL GRADE - I give the team today an F. I honestly cannot point to one person and look at them as having a standout game. Across the board the team sucked from special teams to defense to offense. Usually I can at least say Luck was doing well with what he had, but in this case today, even Luck was not his normal self. Maybe this will be the shot the Colts need to remember they play in the NFL and not in some bush league.
